project.title: For Me, My Father Was Care
project.visual_style: Warm, realistic and nostalgic Ethiopian childhood memories. Natural lighting, intimate family atmosphere, gentle expressions, modest everyday clothing, cinematic realism.

father.description: A fictionalized Ethiopian father inspired by real childhood memories. Middle-aged, warm expression, gentle manner, modest everyday clothing, calm and caring presence.

daughter.description: A fictionalized young Ethiopian girl representing the storyteller during childhood. Curious, cheerful, expressive and strongly attached to her father, wearing simple everyday childhood clothing.

shots.narration_amharic: በጣም ከውስጤ የቀሩ የልጅነት ትዝታዎች፣ ምናልባት ለሌሎች ትንሽ የሚመስሉ ናቸው።
shots.subtitle_english: Some of my strongest childhood memories may seem like small things to others.
shots.visual_prompt: A young Ethiopian girl spending a quiet, warm moment with her father at home, intimate father-daughter relationship, natural expressions, realistic Ethiopian family setting, soft warm light, nostalgic cinematic atmosphere.
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow camera push toward father and daughter with minimal natural movement.

shots.narration_amharic: የአባቴ ቢሮ ከቤታችን ቅርብ ነበር። ሁልጊዜም ከእሱ ጋር መሄድ እፈልግ ነበር።
shots.subtitle_english: My father's office was close to our home, and I would insist on going with him.
shots.visual_prompt: A young Ethiopian girl eagerly asking to accompany her father to his nearby office, then walking happily beside him through an ordinary Ethiopian neighborhood, warm natural daylight, realistic cinematic style.
shots.motion_prompt: Father and daughter walk slowly together while the camera gently follows.

shots.narration_amharic: እሱም “አልወስድሽም” አይለኝም። አብሬው እሄድና፣ ከጎኑ ተቀምጬ ሲሰራ አየው ነበር።
shots.subtitle_english: He wouldn't say no. I would go with him, sit beside him, and watch him work.
shots.visual_prompt: Inside a modest Ethiopian office, a young girl sits happily beside her father's chair watching him work, comfortable and included in his world, subtle office activity in the background, warm realistic cinematic style.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle office activity with a gentle slow camera movement toward father and daughter.

shots.narration_amharic: አይ፣ የልጅነት ነገር! በጉጉት የምጠብቀው ሻይና ዶናት ነበር። አሁንም ጣዕሙ ይሰማኛል።
shots.subtitle_english: Ah, childhood! What I eagerly waited for was tea and donuts. Even now, I can remember the taste.
shots.visual_prompt: An Ethiopian father sharing tea and a donut with his young daughter inside his office, daughter visibly delighted, tea cup and donut clearly visible, intimate childhood memory, warm nostalgic cinematic lighting.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle close-up movement toward the tea, donut and daughter's happy expression.

shots.narration_amharic: ትምህርት ላይ የደከምኩ ሲመስለው ይረዳኛል፣ ይመክረኛል። ጮክ ብሎ ግን አናግሮኝ አያውቅም።
shots.subtitle_english: When he felt I was struggling at school, he helped and guided me. I don't remember him ever speaking to me harshly.
shots.visual_prompt: An Ethiopian father calmly sitting beside his young daughter with schoolbooks and notebooks, patiently helping her study, daughter relaxed and comfortable rather than afraid, warm evening light, realistic cinematic scene.
shots.motion_prompt: Father gently points toward the notebook as his daughter listens, subtle camera push-in.

shots.narration_amharic: በማየት ብቻ የጎደለብኝን ይገነዘብና ትኩረት ይሰጠኝ ነበር።
shots.subtitle_english: He could notice what I was missing just by looking at me, and he would give me the attention I needed.
shots.visual_prompt: Quiet evening in an Ethiopian family home, a caring father notices his young daughter needs attention and responds gently, intimate parent-child connection, soft warm lighting, realistic cinematic atmosphere.
shots.motion_prompt: Father gently notices his daughter and moves closer, with slow and calm camera movement.

shots.narration_amharic: እንክብካቤዎቹ አእምሮዬ ላይ ተቀርጸዋል። እጄንና እግሬን ሲያጥበኝ፣ ቅባት ቀብቶ ማሳጅ ሲያደርግልኝ አልረሳም።
shots.subtitle_english: His acts of care are engraved in my memory. I will never forget him washing my hands and feet, applying cream, and gently massaging them.
shots.visual_prompt: A tender respectful caregiving moment in an Ethiopian family home, a father gently washing his young daughter's hands and feet with warm water and caring for them afterward, child relaxed and secure, emphasis on parental tenderness, warm cinematic lighting.
shots.motion_prompt: Very gentle hand movements with a slow intimate camera push, avoiding sudden motion.

shots.narration_amharic: ለኔ ከባዱ ጊዜ አባቴ ለፊልድ ሥራ ሲሄድ ነበር። አንዳንዴ አልጋዬ ውስጥ ተደብቄ አለቅስ ነበር።
shots.subtitle_english: The hardest times for me were when my father left for fieldwork. Sometimes I would hide in my bed and cry.
shots.visual_prompt: A young Ethiopian girl lying quietly in bed while her father is away for fieldwork, missing him deeply, restrained sadness, modest family bedroom, soft evening light, emotional cinematic realism.
shots.motion_prompt: Nearly still composition with a very slow camera movement toward the child.

shots.narration_amharic: ሲመለስ ግን የሚሰማኝ ደስታ፣ ዓለም የኔ ብቻ የሆነች ነበር የሚመስለኝ።
shots.subtitle_english: But when he returned, I was so happy that it felt as if the whole world were mine.
shots.visual_prompt: An Ethiopian father returning home from fieldwork as his young daughter joyfully welcomes him, genuine excitement and emotional reunion, father smiling warmly, warm late-afternoon light, cinematic realism.
shots.motion_prompt: Daughter moves happily toward her father as he welcomes her, with a gentle camera follow.

shots.narration_amharic: ለኔ አባቴ ማለት ሁሉ ነገሬ ነው።
shots.subtitle_english: For me, my father means everything.
shots.visual_prompt: A simple quiet father-daughter moment expressing deep trust, safety and affection, Ethiopian family setting, emotionally authentic rather than posed, warm golden light, nostalgic cinematic realism.
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow camera push toward father and daughter with a short reflective pause afterward.

shots.narration_amharic: በእኛ ማህበረሰብ ብዙ ጊዜ ትኩረት የሚሰጠው ለእናት ፍቅርና እንክብካቤ ነው። ለኔ ግን፣ ይህን ሁሉ ከአባቴ ነበር ያገኘሁት።
shots.subtitle_english: In our community, we often focus on a mother's love and care. But for me, I found all of that in my father.
shots.visual_prompt: Final warm cinematic image of an Ethiopian father and daughter together, communicating safety, tenderness and lifelong connection, calm and emotionally authentic, golden natural light, realistic nostalgic visual style suitable for a closing scene.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle pull-back followed by a soft fade toward the ending.

shots.narration_amharic: ይህ ፊልም በጄኔሬቲቭ ኤአይ እገዛ የተሰራ ነው።
shots.subtitle_english: This film was created with the assistance of generative AI.
shots.on_screen_text: This film was created with the assistance of generative AI.
